comment: Managed Chromium fallback used only when no system Chrome/Chromium/Edge is installed.
Revisions are chosen to match the Chrome DevTools Protocol revision that chromiumoxide_cdp
0.9.1 was generated from (1566079); the snapshot bucket does not publish every revision for
every platform, so each platform pins the nearest published build.
Digests were produced with: curl -sL <url> | sha256sum
aarch64-apple-darwin has no published snapshot for this revision range; on that host the
engine reports an explicit remediation instead of silently downgrading.
